title: emailModule
responsibility: Define Resend delivery scaffolds, email rendering resources and their integration instructions.

outputs.name: emailModule
outputs.description: Defines the email module (version 1.0.0) with server-only Resend delivery setup and a reusable mailer resource that renders content without sending it. EmailService.send returns { status: "disabled" } only when DISABLE_EMAILS is "true" and otherwise enforces a 100-send, one-hour limit per service instance.

examples.title: Email
examples.description: Transactional email through Resend, with reusable email resources.
instructions: Reference: BuildFlexity separates reusable email content from one Resend delivery boundary.
Configure RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_EMAIL_FROM in project-specific server secrets; never expose them in browser code.
Set DISABLE_EMAILS=true during development. Installation and generation never send emails.
Generate email resources, localize their content, and call EmailService.send with an authorized recipient.
The local rate limit protects one service instance. Use a persistent shared limiter for multi-instance deployments.

setup.contents: export interface EmailEnvironment { RESEND_API_KEY?: string; RESEND_EMAIL_FROM?: string; DISABLE_EMAILS?: string; }

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The thrown Error has message 'Configure the email provider and sender.' when either provider setting is missing; both are required for enabled sends.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The thrown Error has message 'Invalid email message.' when the recipient fails the email-address check, the trimmed subject is empty, or the subject contains a carriage return or newline.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The thrown Error has message 'Email sending rate limit reached.' when an instance has already admitted 100 send attempts in its current one-hour window.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The thrown Error has message 'Email provider usage limit reached.' when Resend responds with HTTP 429.

errors.name: Error
